create_batch_env: create a BatchEnv instance from a list of gym environments with blocking mode enabled
step_batch_env: step the BatchEnv with a batch of actions and return stacked observations rewards and dones
reset_batch_env: reset all or specific environments in the BatchEnv by index and return stacked observations
close_batch_env: close all wrapped environments in the BatchEnv by calling their close methods
review_batch_env_class: review the BatchEnv class that combines multiple environments to step them in batch
